thread:
Ashley: alerts kicked in for hosted-infer.usw2: sustained p95/p99 latency and spike in 5xx for /v1/generate and /v1/chat starting ~12:30Z. Support got multiple customer reports. dashboard: https://redwood.sh/d/hosted-infer/usw2/errors

Mike: oncall here, joining. Which status codes and volumes?

Ashley: seeing a mix of 502 (upstream read timeout) and 504 (gateway timeout). error fraction ~27% for the last 10m, p95 jump to 9.4s. Customers report widespread failures across a few orgs.

Priya: quick query from logs:
```
| index=prod logs
| where service == \"api-gateway\" and path =~ \"/v1/*\" and status_code >= 500
| stats count() by status_code, upstream
```
Top upstream = batcher, gpu-proxy with counts for 502/504.

Jordan: tracing shows a lot of traces terminating at batcher without downstream spans (gpu-proxy missing). We have span gaps between api-gateway -> batcher -> gpu-proxy. Likely batcher stalling and dropping or timing out requests.

infra-bot: METRIC alert: batcher_queue_depth.usw2 = 1260 at 12:33Z (baseline ~25). batcher_processing_latency.p95 = 11.8s. Auto-notify owners.

Miguel: I tried to repro with a real customer payload. curl hangs ~8-12s then returns 502. example:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.sh/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" \
  -d @customer_payload.json
# response: 502 Bad Gateway
# x-request-id: rq_e3b9f4c2
```

Ashley: support checked auth/billing quickly 1 tokens for failing requests are valid and billed. not an auth failure.

Priya: runtime logs from batcher-worker-7:
```
[12:32:58] ERROR enqueue timeout after 5000ms, queue_len=1187
[12:33:02] WARN kv-cache: backend latency spike=780ms, miss_rate increased
[12:33:17] INFO worker: scaling stalled due to cold-start limits
```
This points to backlog + kv-cache cold miss amplifying latency.

Jordan: Suggested immediate mitigations:
- soft-fallback routing: route new requests in us-west-2 to model-variant: xsmall when queue_depth > 200
- rolling restart of batcher autoscaling group (one instance at a time)
- enable detailed traces for sample request-id for 30m

Mike: starting rolling restart of batcher-asg in us-west-2 now, following runbook. Notifying infra-bot to do 1-AZ at a time, 10m maintenance window.

infra-bot: Rolling restart initiated for asg batcher-usw2. Step 1/4 at 12:40Z.

Miguel: Verified fallback routing by forcing model=xsmall, requests return 200 with p95 ~600ms. Good temporary mitigation.

support-bot: customer notified (case CASE-4721). Provided mitigation steps and request-id rq_e3b9f4c2 for debugging.

infra-bot: restart progress: 2/4 done. Observed queue_depth drop from 1260 -> 190. batcher_processing_latency.p95 down to 1.2s.

Mike: after restart and enabling fallback, 5xx rate dropped ~92%. There are still intermittent trace gaps for some requests; likely KV-store pressure or a slow GPU fan-in.

Priya: opened INF-8392 for runtime/serving: summary: transient backpressure in batcher combined with kv-cache miss storm led to request timeouts and 5xx. Attached logs, sample traces, and a repro payload. Assigned to eng-runtime.

Jordan: follow-ups:
- add a synthetic health check that asserts trace continuity across api-gateway -> batcher -> gpu-proxy (fail on missing spans)
- alert when batcher_queue_depth > 200 for >2m with an action playbook
- consider warming KV-cache or adjusting cache TTL/rehydration strategy during spikes

Ashley: support updated customers: mitigation in place (fallback + restarts), monitoring will continue for 60m before handing to runtime. closing immediate triage. :thumbsup:

Mike: adding a short note to postmortems channel and will include RACI for emergent fallback triggers. Ping @oncall if the spike returns.

Ashley: last observed anomalous 5xx at 13:05Z. INF-8392 remains open for RCA and follow-up work.
